high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post by the user "kyliejenner." The post features a person taking a mirror selfie in what appears to be a dressing room or a similar indoor setting. The individual is wearing a white off-the-shoulder mini dress that fits closely to their body, accentuating their figure. They are also wearing beige high-heeled sandals and holding a small white handbag with a chain strap in one hand and a can in the other. The background includes a large mirror reflecting part of the scene, a light-colored wall, and a section of a pink wall on the right side.
